verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API v1 for programmatic access and hints at a Python SDK ('Run Python functions on remote GPUs directly from your local terminal'), plus an open-source CLI (runpodctl) for managing resources — all of which support AI-native building against Runpod. However, there's no dedicated official SDK reference/package documentation (e.g., a Python/JS client library page) beyond the generic REST API and CLI docs. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK docs/repo (Python/JS client library reference), multi-language SDK coverage, and independent developer corroboration of SDK usage.
